title: Solo Kitchen Rush
core_verb: Collect, chop, cook, plate, and serve the same three-ingredient dish repeatedly.
fantasy: A lone chef filling meal orders in a compact restaurant kitchen during one timed shift.
fail_state: The 150-second shift timer reaches zero before 4 completed dishes have been served.
win_state: Deliver 4 correctly completed dishes to the serving window before the shift timer reaches zero.

interaction_tags.meaning: Collectible raw food item; 3 ingredients must be chopped and cooked to create one complete dish.
Goal counter; delivering a plated complete dish here increments orders served by one.

notes: Overcooked's multiplayer co-op kitchen was reduced to one solo chef repeatedly collecting ingredients, chopping and cooking them, plating the result, and serving 4 identical orders during a single timed shift.

scene.description: A cramped restaurant kitchen during peak service, stainless steel counters crowding every wall under warm overhead strip lights. A chopping station, a cooking station, a serving window glowing gold at the far end, and ingredient crates stacked in the corners are what the player runs between. Hanging pots, spice racks, cutting boards, steam and a tiled floor fill the rest; dense, with barely room to turn around.
